name: Ace-High v1.1
body:
# Ace-High v1.1 — release notes and changelog

---

**Ace-High v1.1**

Mod menu for Red Dead Redemption 2 on PS4. **EU `CUSA08519` or US `CUSA03041`, game 1.32 only.** Needs GoldHEN with the Plugin Loader.

Tested on firmware 5.05 and 9.00, **both regions, on real hardware.**

### Added

- **Change Model** — play as any of the **1,859** characters, animals and horses in the game. Split into Protagonists, NPCs (Story, Unique, Townsfolk), Animals (Animals, Horses) and Others, in pages, with real names rather than model ids — *Dutch van der Linde*, not `cs_dutch`. **Use it from chapter 2 onwards; in chapter 1 it kills you.**
- **Arthur keeps his outfit** — change into someone else and back, and Arthur returns in the clothes your save had him in rather than the model's default.
- **Real clothing names** — Custom Clothing shows the game's own name for each garment, *Trilby Hat*, instead of an internal id with a hash on the end.
- **Super Run for wagon teams** — one horse or a full team. Tops out around **80 mph**, will not push while the wagon is off the ground, and is held down over hills so it does not launch. **These numbers are a first pass and will be tuned.**
- **Speed display** — a small bar under the hint showing how fast your horse or wagon is actually going. **Speed Display** on Horse Options or Wagon Options picks Off, MPH or KM/H. Off by default, and your choice is saved.

### Changed

- **Clothing colour variants are numbered** — *Trilby Hat*, *Trilby Hat 2*, *Trilby Hat 3*. The game gives every colour of an item the same name, so repeats are numbered to tell them apart. Every variant is still selectable.
- **Items the game has no name for are numbered** from their category, like *Belt 1* or *Hair 12*, rather than showing a hash. That is the game's own data, not a missing feature.
- **Never Fall Off** is no longer on the Player page. It is on Horse and Wagon, where it applies.

### Removed

- **Explosive Bullet** — the special ammo types do the same job properly.
- **Horse Speed Boost** — Super Run covers it.

### Still being worked on

Auto ride, Honor, horse animations while riding, a few wagon models that will not spawn, a few character models that come out invisible, and the wagon Super Run tuning. Listed in the README so you know they are missing on purpose.

Download `Ace-High.prx` below. **Install instructions and everything else are in the README.**

Single player only.

Thanks to **ricardoofnl** for the cowboy-menu base, used with permission.
